# enhancements, one game after another:
# = <title id> <name>
# <enhancement> | <build> | <who made it> | <what to know about it>
# <code lines>
# the build is any, rev<remaster version> for a cartridge without an update,
# or update <major>.<minor> for a game with that update. each code here was
# tested on its build in Zakuro, where it doubled the frames the game draws.
# the 60 FPS codes come from the 60 FPS cheat thread on GBAtemp and Reshiban's
# collection of them. most of these games count time in frames, so they run
# faster too, which the note says where the code's author said so or where
# it showed in testing. turning an enhancement off puts back what its code
# changed, so a game goes back to its own frame rate.

# public: Haiku runs one game, Fire Emblem Fates, which has no entry here, so
# the list of other games' community codes is left out.
